messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — aiming to cut release branch tomorrow 10:00 PT. Need final lockfile bump + vendor sync today. Can owners do submodule merges before 18:00 PT? :calendar:

Rob: on it. I have a vendor bump PR in flight (https://git.company/pr/4821). Will rebase and push by 15:30 PT.

Sami: tagging release notes here — if you're changing public APIs, add a short bullet in CHANGELOG.md and ping me. small edits are fine after vendor sync but no new features after branch cut.

Maya: @Rob please ensure dep bump doesn't change go mod sums unexpectedly. Run `make vendor-sync` and paste the diff.

Rob: yup running now. output looks clean.

DevBot: CI build started for rob/vendor-bump #4821 — all checks passing :white_check_mark:

Tina: FYI I'll do a pass on submodules in infra/ and tools/ around 16:00 PT. If you need merges earlier, drop a note.

Lee: note for folks doing submodule merges: use `git submodule update --remote` then `git add` + single commit. Also watch for binary vendors (>5mb) — those should go through eng-infra.

Maya: Also: don't forget to bump the package.json version for the console package if you touch web assets. small PRs are ok but please mark them 'release: patch' label.

Sami: tagging @release-captain — @Maya what's our freeze window? Is it strict after 18:00 PT?

Maya: Freeze is soft at 18:00 PT — only critical bugfixes after that, with approval from @Maya or @Sami. We want a clean vendor + lockfile state for build reproducibility.

Rob: merged and pushed vendor lockfile bump. SHA: abc1234. CI green. @Maya can you confirm you'd like me to open the release branch now or wait for Tina's infra merges?

Maya: Wait for Tina's infra merges. If they land before 17:30 PT, open branch at 18:00 PT; otherwise postpone to 20:00 PT. Thanks y'all :rocket:

Tina: infra merges done at 16:20 PT. No conflicts.

Maya: Ok I'm creating the release branch now. Remember to tag PRs that were in this batch with `rel/2027-03-xx` and add changelog snippets.

DevBot: release branch created: rel/2027-03-xx by Maya

Rob: quick note — I included a small vendor patch that changes one API surface; added changelog entry under 'internal changes' and bumped minor version.

Sami: good call. We'll do a smoke test on staging after the branch cut. I'll pull a few smoke prompts for the inference runtime and check latency.

Maya: Great. I'll post a followup thread tomorrow with rollout schedule and canary percentages.
